experiments.title: Cryogenic Microwave Cavity Impedance Transmission Test
experiments.hypothesis: H1: The prefactor 1/2 in Z_0/(2*R_K) generates a physical boundary phase shift Delta_phi = (1/2)*(Z_0/R_K) in an asymmetric microwave cavity.
experiments.null_hypothesis: H0: Transmission across cavity boundaries obeys standard Maxwell-Fresnel boundary conditions with zero anomalous prefactor shift (Delta_phi = 0).
experiments.baseline: Standard QED Maxwell wave equation eigenmodes in superconducting niobium cavity (Q > 10^9).
experiments.expected_observable: Anomalous resonant frequency shift delta_f / f_0 and boundary phase lag Delta_phi.

controls.negative_control: Impedance-matched 50-Ohm cryogenic coaxial line (zero resonant cavity).
controls.positive_control: Symmetric Fabry-Perot cavity with calibrated sapphire dielectric perturbation.

experiments.falsification_criterion: If measured |delta_f / f_0| <= 3.0 * sigma (no anomalous shift detected above 1e-7), H1 is ruled out and the physical field-pair interpretation is formally REFUTED.

experiments.title: Hybrid Normal-Superconducting Ring Aharonov-Bohm Phase Slip
experiments.hypothesis: H1: The pairing factor (1/2)^n produces intermediate fractional fluxoid conductance oscillations at (1/4)*Phi_0 in hybrid ring geometries.
experiments.null_hypothesis: H0: Fluxoid quantization transitions strictly between h/e and h/2e according to BCS pairing order parameter Psi with zero fractional intermediate states.
experiments.baseline: Mesoscopic Landauer-Buttiker conductance oscillations under external magnetic flux.
experiments.expected_observable: Fourier amplitude of magnetoconductance at flux frequencies f = 1/Phi_0 and f = 2/Phi_0.

controls.positive_control: Continuous aluminum superconducting ring (pure h/2e period).

experiments.falsification_criterion: If Fourier spectrum exhibits zero amplitude at 4/Phi_0 (fractional prefactor) within 3-sigma noise floor, H1 is formally REFUTED.
